name: idc-uw-cirp-mouse-pet-ct-nsclc
description: 18F-FDG PET/CT imaging of 14 genetically-engineered mouse models (GEMM) of lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSQ) from the NCI Co-Clinical Imaging Resource Program (Co-CIRP). 11 animals were imaged before and after a novel combination therapy (anti-PD-L1 + CXCR2 antagonist), with 3 additional baseline-only animals. The dataset includes 25 imaging sessions with 75 DICOM series (25 PT, 25 CT, 25 RTSTRUCT segmentations) acquired on a Siemens Inveon PET/CT system. Please see the UW-CIRP-Mouse-PET-CT-NSCLC Zenodo page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
